lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Notebooks are out of the trailer and off this site. Your engineer carried the crate herself, both arms, three hundred metres, and would not let anybody take one end of it.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Four hundred and six names with the labour board, published, and me looking for work by Monday. Worth it, probably. Ask me again in March.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Back in his jacket, and neither of us has mentioned it since. I've two children and a rotation that ends in March. That's the whole of my reasoning and I've stopped dressing it up.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Canteen's through there and the rota's on the wall.
